name: print-social-fireplace-home-posts-slate-and-blush-with-script-accents
title: Fireplace home pack in slate blue and blush with cosy photos and italic script words
whatItIs: Nine square posts with a slate blue and blush palette, cosy photos of couples and a woman reading by a fire, serif headlines with italic accents ('Create a warm home with the Perfect fireplace'), circle '25% off' badges and a round fireplace logo.
whatItMeans: Soft and inviting; muted cool tones framing warm firelight feel serene and homely.
techniques: Frame warm photos with cool muted panels.
Italicise the key noun in a serif headline.
Use a round logo seal and matching discount circle.

vocabulary.definition: Low-saturation colours for a calm feel.
